verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v1: wash-shaykhu ʾaḥmadu tijjān mayamka warna jariwyah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v2: quṭbu l-wujūdi fashaykhī yallā kumay mayī māmyah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v3: faman yulāzimu quṭbī wattūfku mūk dakadumyah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v4: lā taḍjarū yā ʾunāsī jakkantalīn jamja yūnyah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v5: man kāna yadkhulu fīhā mumujju mūs ʾak jujamyah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v6: ḍamāntu min rasūli mayamka mūm mūdi biryah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v7: bidhākumu jalla qadrā mūtakh muʾam kanji mayyah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v8: fawqa th-tharā wath-thurayyā kannā kuwī kāyū bākhyah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v9: wajawzahīru maqālu mūm mūkuwakh kisna yafyah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v10: laqad ʿalat qadamāyā jakūri yalla yuwūryah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v11: famuntahā qawli shaykhī bay buftu wal mūy yuwuryah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v14: kadhāka ʾālu waṣaḥbu muy wiy diwiy ʾak karamyah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v12: khudhū bihi ʾin ʾaradtum jis sīn burūm ʾak likiy yah
verses.washshaykhu-ahmadu-tijjan-c1-v13: ʿalā n-nabiyyī muḥammad khīwal kusakh ʾak musalyah
